page0.text:
It is daybreak.
The knight in red is leaning against the pillar and staring at his own arm.
He puts strength into his fingertips and clenches his fist.
Only about half of his sensations are left.
Even though he is a Heroic Spirit, he cannot maintain his existence without a Master that helps him stay in this world.
Archer is existing because of a special ability that his class holds, but that is nearing its limit.

page1.text:
The knight in red's remaining strength is less than a tenth of his original powers.
His fists lack strength, and he should slowly start fading if he lets his guard down.

page2.text:
...
But there is no problem.
Even if he only has a tenth of his powers remaining, it is enough to finish Shirou Emiya off.
Considering the difference in their abilities, this is not even a handicap.
Therefore, it will end once they fight.
His one and only objective will be accomplished here.

page3.text:
...
...That is right.
He has been waiting for this moment.
He has endured the endless repetition, hoping for this chance.
He could only wait for a miracle that would not usually be able to occur, with a possibility close to zero.

page4.text:
And his wish is granted.
No, it is about to be granted.
...He does not care about what awaits him afterwards.
He will kill his own self with his own hands.
That wish, which doesn't have enough of a future to be hope, is what kept him going after he wore out.

page5.text:
"...Was it long? Or was it an instant?"
He is an existence that disappears after each summoning to start with.
His memory does not remain intact, whether he repeats that cycle 100 times or 1000 times.
It only stays in his body as knowledge.
Heroic Spirits know about other Heroic Spirits because they have accumulated knowledge.

page6.text:
It is just like a book.
Every time they are summoned, the book with its history is sent to its home.
They remain in the house and read the books that are sent.
What is troubling is that the one at the house does not know when those books are sent.

page7.text:
The past or future does not matter.
All the "books" are already in his room.
His only way of measuring time is to read the records of his "cleaning" that he will carry out.

page8.text:
It makes no difference whether it's an eternity or an instant.
An eternity is an instant, and an instant is an eternity.
Therefore, he does not know how rare this miracle is.
He doesn't know whether it was the first time or a thousandth time he was summoned since he gained this hope.
...All he has is this unordered knowledge.
The future, past, and present are all things that Heroic Spirits don't have.

page9.text:
"...A visitor, eh? I chose this place since I was told there would be no interruptions here."
The knight in red suddenly gets up.
Did his ears hear an intruder?
Footsteps echo through the castle that should be silent.

page10.text:
"...Wow. I'm surprised, Tohsaka. I was skeptical, but you're actually here."
The voice echoes.
The boy who entered rudely is Shinji Matou.

page11.text:
"Hey now... No funny business, Archer.
I have no business with you. You don't have any business with Tohsaka either, right? Then isn't it meaningless for us to fight here?"
Shinji Matou walks over with light steps.
He is looking at Rin Tohsaka who is tied to a chair.
The girl doesn't say anything and stares at the intruder, while being tied up.
That must make him pleased.
Shinji Matou licks his lips in satisfaction and walks to the girl.

page12.text:
...
"What?"
Shinji Matou glances in annoyance at the knight, who is staring down at him in silence.
"What, you wanna fight? Are you serious? You'd be no match for me!"
Shinji Matou smiles and returns to the entrance.

page13.text:
There stands the golden haired boy... The eighth Servant, Gilgamesh.
He himself is a disaster.
The golden Servant looks at the knight with cool eyes.
But within them...
The red eyes distorted from his smile only have the intention to murder the enemy in front of him.

page14.text:
...
The knight in red is still silent.
It makes no difference whether Shinji Matou appears or the strongest Servant in front of him is ready to attack him.
The knight calmly stares at the uninvited enemies.

page15.text:
"Haha, you're scared, right, Archer? It's fine, nothing to be ashamed of. He's the Servant who killed Berserker without difficulty. It's natural for you to be scar—"
"...Do you want Rin, Shinji Matou?"
"Huh...? Y-yeah, of course. There's no other reason for me to come close to this castle."

page16.text:
"I see. Then wait until things are over. I will give her to you once I get rid of Shirou Emiya.
She is mine until then. It cannot be helped if you cannot compromise on that... It is regrettable, but you will die here, Gilgamesh."
The knight in red declares, still staring at the golden Servant.

page17.text:
"Very funny, fool."
Was that statement itself good enough reason for the man to kill Archer?
The golden Servant identifies the knight in red in front of him as a target he must kill.

page18.text:
"Wait, Gilgamesh. Don't be rash, let's be smart. Come on, he's saying he'll give her to me, so I'll let him.
Archer doesn't have a Master. I'm sure there's no Master who would form a contract with him after how many times he betrayed people, so he'll disappear if we let him be. I can take Tohsaka after that."

page19.text:
Shinji Matou stares at the red knight, still smiling.
His eyes look as if he's enjoying the fate of one who is about to disappear soon.

page20.text:
"How smart, Shinji Matou. That decision is accurate. In that regard, you are most suitable as a Master."
"Oh, you show promise! What a waste, I would've formed a contract with you had you come to me!"
Stepping away from the knight in red, Shinji Matou claps his hands happily.

page21.text:
"But I'm sorry, I don't need any more Servants. It's unfortunate, but you'll have to disappear here."
"You do not need to tell me. So what will you do? Will you fight me, or wait until I disappear?"

page22.text:
"Yeah, I'll wait. We'll protect Tohsaka until you get rid of Emiya.
But, that's right. In that case, that thing is mine already, right? Then don't you think I can do anything to her now?"

page23.text:
He looks at the knight in red and Rin Tohsaka with snake-like eyes.
Those words test the loyalty of the knight in red.
To that...
"...The agreement with Shirou Emiya was that she will not be harmed, but that will disappear by dawn. You can do as you wish once the time comes."
The knight in red answers in an emotionless voice.

page24.text:
"Ha... Haha, ahahahahahahahahahahaha!"
Did you hear that, Tohsaka? Your Servant is selling off his Master!"
Sneering laughter echoes through the dingy room.
The red knight leaves the room, as if he has no interest.

page25.text:
...
...
He passes by Gilgamesh.
He goes into the hallway, ignoring the red eyes that look at him, amused.
At that moment...
